TMax-15K.reason: Grid search over a small discrete parameter space, each point scored by an external evaluator; same loop as searching synonym choices against pdflatex.
Must iteratively refine output until an opaque external scorer crosses a threshold, while minimising perturbation - same tool-in-the-loop optimisation.
Hard edit restriction (Makefile only, sources untouchable) plus diagnosing a build toolchain that succeeds but produces wrong output.
Must make a build emit no diagnostics at all under -Wall -Werror; same read-the-compiler-log-and-iterate discipline, different compiler.
-Werror turns a warning into a build gate; solving requires reading the diagnostic back to the offending source line, as with hbox warnings.
Repair sources and a broken Makefile until compilation is warning-free; iterate-until-toolchain-is-silent, no search component though.
Explicitly instructs iterative refinement until an adversarial verifier reports 100%; same close-the-loop-on-a-checker habit.
Refine a program against provided accept/reject corpora until every case passes; iterative convergence against an external oracle.
Grid search over a one-dimensional space minimising a distance metric; the search-over-discrete-choices half of the TB2.1 task.
Explicit whitelist of editable files while fixing a build; teaches respecting a restricted edit surface but nothing about typesetting or search.

Recursive-Task-Synthesis.reason: Compile a .tex with pdflatex until cross-references resolve: same compiler, same need to re-run and read the LaTeX log.
pdflatex is deliberately broken; requires diagnosing the TeX distribution from its error output before any document will build.
PDF must contain no '??' placeholders, so pdflatex must be re-run until that artifact disappears - iterate-until-the-log-is-clean in LaTeX.
Resolve every documentation-build warning until the build reports zero; identical loop of build, read warnings, edit source, rebuild.
Requires keeping and inspecting the pdflatex compilation log as an artifact; same habit of treating the TeX log as the source of truth.
Same zero-warnings Sphinx gate with profile selection; transfers the discipline of eliminating every diagnostic, not just building.
Clean rebuild with all warnings enabled and confirm zero remain; a build-until-silent gate, but in C rather than TeX.
A static analyser must report no warnings on one file while still flagging another; teaches reading analyser output precisely, not just making it run.
Generate LaTeX with required layout markers, compile with pdflatex, then pass a validator; LaTeX toolchain plus an external pass/fail gate.
pandoc plus pdflatex with a content checklist to verify before finishing; right toolchain, but no diagnostic loop or constrained edits.

TerminalWorld-Seeds-Clean.reason: Compile showcase.tex to a valid PDF with a third-party LaTeX document class; getting pdflatex to succeed from its own error output is the whole task.
Fill a template.tex from data and compile the result to PDF; same edit-tex-then-recompile cycle, though no warning gate.
Build a whole book to PDF from a source tree; long multi-pass document toolchain where the build log is the only feedback.
Produce a standalone .tex from HTML; exercises writing valid LaTeX source, the artefact the TB2.1 task must edit correctly.
Conversion must go through a LaTeX intermediate and then compile, plus an evidence bundle; real pdflatex driving, weak diagnostic component.
HTML to standalone .tex to PDF; same toolchain but the success criterion is only that a PDF exists.
Get a documentation build to complete by installing missing extensions; iterating on a doc toolchain's errors, different renderer.
Run a static analyser on two variants and compare which warnings each emits; teaches reading analyser output as the deliverable.
Must satisfy several sequential quality gates (syntax, lint, idempotence) before completion; shape of repeated tool gating only.
Another CV-to-PDF via LaTeX intermediate; domain overlap only, no diagnostics and no constrained edit surface.

SWE-Smith-Seeds-Clean.reason: The line-length rule's non-breakable-word logic is exactly the overfull-hbox condition: a token that cannot be broken inside the allowed width.
Same line-length rule, non-breakable words and inline mappings; reasoning about when an over-width line is legitimately unfixable.
Fix the LaTeX formatter's emitted markup; requires knowing what valid LaTeX output looks like and how its options interact.
LineWrap must measure printable width correctly when escape sequences inflate the string; the measure-then-break reasoning behind hbox overflow.
LatexEmbeddedLexer bug; same LaTeX territory and same need to reason about escaping inside TeX source.
Terminal LineWrap and coloured-text helpers; text-to-fixed-width layout, but a narrower API-level fix.
Reindent/reflow of SQL text output; exercises producing correctly laid-out text from a token stream.
Output should wrap or break long argument lists at a length limit; the same fit-text-into-a-width decision.
Document-model layout code (paragraphs, sections) in a page-oriented format; adjacent territory, no line-breaking reasoning.
PDF text layout analysis; shares the page-geometry subject matter but the task is parsing, not producing, typeset output.

SWE-Rebench-Tasks-Clean.reason: Hyphenation fails when an nbsp sits in the word, so the line cannot be broken and overflows - literally the overfull-hbox mechanism in a PDF layout engine.
A docstring refuses to wrap to the configured width because of surrounding lines; same fit-text-to-a-width failure and its diagnosis.
Text duplicated in generated PDF with RTL runs; debugging a paginating layout engine by inspecting its rendered output.
A line that is too long and cannot be reformatted must still pass the linter; reasoning about unavoidable over-width lines.
WeasyPrint rendering configuration; same HTML-to-PDF typesetting stack, though the fix is config rather than layout maths.
Run a validation tool over the sources and keep editing until it reports no violations; the same converge-to-a-clean-report workflow.
Regression in how the formatter applies its max line length; requires reproducing width-sensitive output exactly.
Wrapping inserts spurious breaks around hyperlinks; an atom that must not be split across lines, as with an unbreakable TeX box.
Failure in Sphinx's LaTeX builder; same document-to-LaTeX pipeline, but debugged from a Python traceback rather than a TeX log.
Blank-line handling around docstrings; text-reformatting territory with no width or breakability reasoning.

final_top10.reason: Same compiler: must run pdflatex repeatedly and read its log until cross-references resolve, on a real .tex file.
A word that cannot be hyphenated overflows its line - the exact mechanism producing an overfull hbox, debugged in a layout engine.
Compile a .tex against a third-party LaTeX class to a valid PDF; the whole task is driving pdflatex off its own errors.
Must re-run pdflatex until a specific artifact ('??') disappears from the PDF - iterate-until-the-TeX-diagnostic-is-gone.
Exhaustive search over a small discrete option space, each candidate scored by invoking an external program - the synonym search loop.
pdflatex itself is broken and must be diagnosed from its output before any document compiles; deep familiarity with the TeX toolchain.
Line-length rule and non-breakable tokens: deciding when an over-width line can be fixed by rewording and when it cannot.
Iteratively refine until an opaque external scorer passes, while minimising how much the input is perturbed.
Resolve every documentation build warning until the build emits zero; the build-read-warnings-edit-rebuild loop in a different renderer.
Text refuses to wrap to the configured width; diagnosing why a reflow engine leaves a line over the limit.

notes: LaTeX is nearly absent from the pool: TMax-15K has zero LaTeX/pdflatex tasks (verified by regex over all 15k instructions), so its ten are scored purely on transfer of the two underlying skills - discrete search driven by an external evaluator, and iterating a build tool until its diagnostics are clean. RTS is dominated by two near-duplicate families (online-CV->pdflatex conversion, and Sphinx zero-warnings builds); I deliberately took at most three from each family, so the merge step should expect heavy near-duplication among RTS ids if other agents picked from the same clusters. Best single find outside the shortlist is kozea__weasyprint-2416 (hyphenation/unbreakable-word line overflow), which no retriever surfaced. The dominant false positive in the shortlist was the 'convert online-CV to PDF' cluster (tw_48*, tw_49*, many rts_*): it shares pdflatex but has no diagnostic loop and no constrained edit surface, so I scored it 2.
